approval: All phases of inline draft-1 approved by user; unresolved upstream details explicitly treated as emulator deviations.

additionalEvidence.facts: data.ID Geographic2D:EPSG::4326; record id has osdu:reference-data--CoordinateReferenceSystem: prefix; request recordId terminates in colon; Kind geographic 2D/projected; persistable reference has authCode,name,type,ver,wkt.
Jackson/Gson wire name baseMeasurement (not generated interface schema baseMeasurementEssence); USO scale-offset and UM measurement types.

excluded: All other public operations, v2, arbitrary CRS/unit definitions, datum/vertical/dynamic/grid transformations, general ABCD conversion.

decisions.coordinates: Accept JSON numbers and strict decimal/exponent strings, rejecting bool/null/nonfinite. Output x/y/z and successCount as strings following generated schema, despite numeric request examples.
decisions.failedPointEvidence: String NaN is a deliberate emulator policy, NOT verified upstream runtime serialization. A malformed point fails the request; an out-of-domain point fails individually.
decisions.crsReferences: Only JSON-serialized LBC references returned by this catalog. Exact structural match, including WKT and metadata, irrespective of JSON formatting/key order. No bare EPSG, record IDs, alternate WKT, or arbitrary definitions in convert.
decisions.crsVersion: OSDU-Lite/pyproj-3.7.2; local WKT2 not upstream PE WKT.
decisions.catalogProjection: Local nested projection: default id,kind,data.ID,data.Name,data.Code,data.CodeSpace,data.Kind,data.PersistableReference. returnedFields supports existing record paths only; unsupported paths fail. returnAllFields overrides returnedFields.
decisions.catalogQuery: Local diagnostic only, never executed by Search. Exact code/ID and case-insensitive name substring; AND semantics; deterministic numeric-code order.
decisions.catalogId: recordId requires exactly one trailing colon; dataId/id match data.ID without trailing colon. Unknown well-formed recordId/dataId gives 404.
decisions.unitNamespace: osdu-lite only; upstream catalog namespace/symbol/ancestry metadata could not be verified. No implied acceptance of an official namespace. These are local SI-based curated definitions.
decisions.unitEssence: USO with symbol, baseMeasurement {type:UM,ancestry}, scaleOffset to canonical basis. Only exact catalog essences accepted; supplied coefficients must be finite JSON numbers, not strings.
decisions.entitlementEvidence: Explicit emulator-local names; upstream role constants not established.
decisions.limits: 1 MiB new-service bodies; 1000 points; unsupported/duplicate/blank parameters rejected; old JSON handling unchanged.
decisions.compliance: Partial community API emulation only. No OSDU Standard v1.0 compliance claim.

dependencies.hashes: requirements.txt: selected CPython 3.11/3.12 Windows x64, manylinux and musllinux amd64/arm64 wheels plus universal certifi wheel. Source distributions disallowed.
dependencies.runtime: Bundled PROJ database; PROJ_NETWORK=OFF and pyproj.network.set_network_enabled(False). Actual versions recorded during validation, not inferred from wheel availability.
